projection: linear local, 1 block = 1 m, north = -Z (matches build-heritage-register.py to_block)

module.note: The 4 m module and the firewall every five bays are the legal rhythm (MR55 ข้อ 2, ข้อ 4, ข้อ 17) applied to screened footprints. They are not a survey of the actual party walls. Over-cap rows are tagged, not broken. Storeys default to 2 where Overture is silent — the modal known value in this world, graded interpretive-storeys. Shop openings, upper windows, the 1 m awning, the rear courtyard void (depth > 16 m) and the stair shaft are the same kind of fact: typological rhythm, not a survey of the actual openings.

palette.why: Sandstone body, stone-brick party wall, brick firewall rising one block above the roof. The roof is terracotta so a long row reads as a row, not a monument. Oak awning at the first-floor line; glass for the upper windows. Openings and the courtyard are air.
